author: dealvz
title: fix(sms): show the free texts off the review step total on a hold
body:
Candidates on Win SMS hold billing saw "5,000 free texts included" on the review step, but the Total and the amount-due line still showed the full price (18,354 texts read $642.39 instead of $467.39). The charge itself was right. The hold authorizes the undiscounted amount and capture takes the free texts off once the list is final. The page never showed that, so candidates stopped at payment thinking the offer wasn't being applied.

To fix it, the review step has to know whether the session amount already has the free texts off. An immediate charge does; a hold does not. gp-api now returns `isHold` on the checkout session, taken from the same decision that sets manual capture, instead of having the browser read the `win_sms_hold_billing` flag itself. The browser's flag read can lag or disagree with the server's, and a wrong guess would show a total lower than the real charge, which is worse than today's bug.

The free texts line now shows its value (−$175.00), and the read-only summary in build mode takes the free texts off its estimate too, since it had the same gap.

The card is still authorized for the full amount until capture, so a bank app can show the bigger pending figure. The pay note now says "Your bank may show a temporary hold of $642.39." on a hold the free texts reduce, so the confusion doesn't just move to the bank statement. Holding the discounted amount instead would change the send cap (it is derived from the hold) and leave a send that loses the offer in a race short at capture, so that stays out of a display fix.

Not changed: the "Discounted Total" Stripe shows inside the payment form after a promo code still reads the hold amounts.

Fixes [5K Free is not working on the first campaign](https://goodparty.clickup.com/t/90132012119/ENG-11344).
